policy: Patterns are structural options, not templates. Select only when task, mode and content prerequisites match.

modeDefinitions.persuade: Visitor decides and acts; marketing and product explanation.
modeDefinitions.operate: User completes a task; product UI and tools.
modeDefinitions.read: User understands information; documentation and long-form content.
modeDefinitions.experience: User encounters an artifact or brand world; portfolio and showcase.

patterns.name: Task-first workspace
patterns.composition: Keep primary task, current object and next action visible; use stable navigation and a flexible work area.
patterns.when: Recurring work with related views.
patterns.avoid: Decorative cards before the main task.
requiredContent: Real task content and labels
Loading, empty, error and success states where relevant
patterns.responsive: Preserve task-critical content; collapse secondary chrome without hiding essential context.
patterns.accessibility: Use semantic landmarks, keyboard-operable controls, visible focus and persistent labels; verify actual contrast.
